name: I got isekaid to an island of horny goats, what do i do?
source:
You awaken on a remote island ruled by goat folk. Your quest? Figure out how the hell you got here – and what they want from you.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你在一个由山羊人统治的偏远岛屿上醒来。你的追求？弄清楚你到底是怎么来到这里的——以及他们想从你这里得到什么。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
